title: RIOJA. JWST and ALMA Unveil the Inhomogeneous and Complex Interstellar Medium Structure in a Star-forming Galaxy at z = 6.81
question: Investigate whether a density stratification of highly ionized gas in the z = 6.81 star-forming galaxy COS-2987 can be identified by combining rest-frame optical (JWST/NIRSpec IFS) and far-infrared (ALMA) [O III] emission lines.

data.sensitivity: 0.576 mJy beam^-1 per 30 km s^-1 channel; 82.6 mJy beam^-1 km s^-1 in moment-0 map

recipe.goal: Reduce JWST NIRSpec IFS data and extract optical emission line fluxes
recipe.method: Process raw G395H/F290LP data with JWST pipeline, apply sigma clipping and median background subtraction, drizzle to 0.05'' pixels, match PSF to Halpha (0.21'' FWHM), extract spectra from >= 2sigma region in [O III]5008 map, fit Gaussians to line profiles, and apply 10% aperture correction.
key_parameters: pixel size = 0.05'', PSF FWHM = 0.21'' at 5.125 um, extraction threshold >= 2 sigma in [O III]5008 map, aperture correction = 10%
assumptions: Adopted aperture misses ~10% of total flux based on curve-of-growth analysis

recipe.goal: Image ALMA Band 8 data and measure [O III] 88 um line flux and profile
recipe.method: Image Band 8 data with CASA tclean using natural weighting, integrate cube over 434.2-434.9 GHz (480 km s^-1) to make moment-0 map, measure integrated line flux, and fit 1D velocity profile with a single Gaussian corrected for instrumental broadening.
key_parameters: natural weighting, 30 km s^-1 channel width, integration range 434.2-434.9 GHz (480 km s^-1)

recipe.goal: Derive integrated dust extinction, electron temperature, electron density, and gas-phase metallicity from optical lines
recipe.method: Iteratively compute dust extinction A_V from Halpha/Hbeta Balmer decrement, electron temperature Te([O III]) from [O III]4364/5008, Te([O II]) from scaling relation, electron density ne([O II]) from [O II]3730/3727, and oxygen abundance 12+log(O/H) via direct-Te method using PyNeb.
key_parameters: Convergence threshold delta_Te < 10 K; 10,000 Monte Carlo realizations
assumptions: SMC extinction curve with R_V = 2.74; Case B recombination with initial ne = 100 cm^-3 and Te = 10^4 K; Galactic extinction negligible; Te([O II]) = 0.7 * Te([O III]) + 3000 K; O/H = O++/H+ + O+/H+

recipe.goal: Test inhomogeneous dust distribution via spatially resolved pixel-by-pixel dust correction
recipe.method: Apply Voronoi pixel binning to Hbeta and Halpha intensity maps within 3sigma regions, generate an A_V map, correct [O III]4364 and [O III]5008 maps pixel-by-pixel, and measure total fluxes using 2sigma isophotal aperture of [O III]5008 with 10% aperture correction.
key_parameters: 3sigma threshold for Halpha and Hbeta maps; 2sigma [O III]5008 isophotal aperture; 10% aperture correction
assumptions: A_V = 0 outside the 3sigma detection region of Halpha and Hbeta

recipe.goal: Model [O III] 4364, 5008, and 88 um line ratios with a two-component density-stratified ionized gas toy model
recipe.method: Calculate cooling rates Lambda_line for two ionized gas components using PyNeb and combine their line luminosities linearly as a function of volume ratio V1/V2 to reproduce observed [O III]88/5008 and [O III]4364/5008 ratios.
assumptions: n_O++,i = n_e,i * 10^-4 (12 + log(O++/H+) = 8); 10% absolute flux calibration uncertainty on both [O III]5008 and [O III]88
